info.title: Noctara Human Registry
info.summary: Proof-of-human verification over consented, person-owned behavioral records.
info.description: Verify whether a person is present and continuous via a consented, person-owned append-only behavioral record. Returns four claims (is_human, is_continuous, has_deviated, stands_behind) with provenance. A zero-auth fixture demo is at GET /api/v1/registry-demo so an agent can see the exact response shape without a key. Real checks require a bearer license key AND the person's recorded consent to the calling organization: no grant, no claims. This is a proof-of-human presence signal, NOT a consumer report; it must never be used for credit, employment or hiring, housing, or insurance eligibility, or for background checks or risk scoring (FCRA-prohibited uses). Revocation stops answers instantly.

get.summary: Zero-auth fixture check (see the response shape without a key)
get.description: Returns a FIXTURE record so a caller can see the exact shape a real check returns. No real person is behind it.

get.summary: Check the four claims for a consented person
get.description: Returns the four claims for the person identified by `tag`, but ONLY if that person has granted the calling organization. Without a grant, `visible` is false and `claims` is null (never a false 'no'). Requires a bearer license key.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The subject's tag (alphanumeric, up to 16 chars).

200.description: A registry response. `visible:true` with claims when granted; `visible:false` with `status:pending_consent` and `claims:null` when not granted.

licenseKey.description: A Noctara license key. Request one at https://noctaracorp.com/developers.

Claims.description: Each claim is true when evidenced, false only when evidenced-negative, and null when not established (never a false 'no').

is_human.description: Presence signal over an accruing record (>= 2 beats, or a measured live typing session). Not a calibrated biometric.

has_deviated.description: A drift observation is present in the record.

stands_behind.description: The person stands behind their record.

visible.description: True only when the person has granted the calling org.

permitted_use.description: The FCRA boundary that travels with every response.

x-permitted-use.consent: claims are served only to an organization the person has granted; revocation stops answers instantly
